cohort: The study included 1,219 women undergoing cesarean sections under spinal or combined spinal-epidural anesthesia with plain ropivacaine between 2018 and 2022.
finding: The incidence of spinal-induced hypotension in women undergoing cesarean section linearly correlated with the plain ropivacaine dose, with a dose threshold for hypotension risk of 17.5 mg.
